column1: # Italian province codes: the UPU Italy sheet (04/2020, "List of provinces") lists 101; Caserta (CE), Gorizia (GO), Nuoro (NU), Pordenone (PN), Trieste (TS) and Udine (UD) are missing there and are added from ISO 3166-2:IT, so 107 in all.
# A code of two capitals after the locality on the last line is the province (UPU Italy sheet: "postcode + locality + province code").
